value.reason: The evidence is a config value at challenges.metricsIgnoredUserAgents[0]. It is an entry in a list of user-agent strings that are left out of metrics collection. User-agent strings describe a client's browser, device or bot, so they are technical profile or device-characteristic data. It is not a government ID, biometric, financial, health, child, authentication-secret or contact field. It is most likely a static bot or crawler pattern and not tied to one person, so it is low sensitivity. Profile is the closest of the allowed categories.
